_comment: Editorial content for PPP. Every fact here is attributable — see sourceNote. No image is attached. Note: PPP here is Pakistan Paper Products Limited, a paper-converting company — not a power-project security.
description: Pakistan Paper Products Limited is a paper-converting company founded in 1951 by Hashim B. Sayeed, converted into a public limited company in 1964 and quoted on the Karachi Stock Exchange; it describes itself as one of the oldest listed companies on the Pakistan Stock Exchange. From its plant on Estate Avenue in S.I.T.E., Karachi, it produces self-adhesive labels in roll form and exercise books.
headOffice: D-58, Estate Avenue, S.I.T.E., Karachi 75700, Pakistan
